markers.//: Keyed on the NAMED fence. Until 0.8 these were `:{3,}`, so after the respelling folding a block silently stopped working — and nothing tested this file, which is why it took reading it to find. The lookahead excludes a one-liner: `:span: x :!span:` opens and closes on its line, so a fold starting there would never end.

onEnterRules.//: Inside a block, stay inside it: the closer is already below, so a new line should not run out of the construct the author is working in. Also keyed on `:{3,}` until 0.8, and also silently dead after the respelling.
